newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel diffs steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel diffs steady in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel markets were characterized by steady cash differentials and light volumes of trade at the U.S. Gulf Coast Wednesday, with action in New York Harbor even quieter, traders said.

Underlying heating oil futures on the NYMEX were lower in part due to a million barrel build in distillates in the East line with a build in overall distillate inventories. Jet fuel inventories meanwhile rose by 631,000 barrels to 38.5 million.
In Houston, prompt airline-quality 54-grade and low sulphur 55-grade jet traded at 0.75 and 0.35 cent under June NYMEX heat respectively.
